newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani rupee ends up in kerb.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani rupee ends up in kerb.

text.p: The Pakistani rupee ended 0.10 up at 41.45 to the dollar on Saturday as supply of the U.S. currency was higher than its demand, dealers said.
"The demand for the dollar remained low compared to its flow because local players are short of cash," a dealer said.
The State (central) Bank of Pakistan rate, last changed on May 23, was 40.3900/40.5920 against the dollar.
The premium on foreign exchange bearer certificates closed at 2.60 percent compared to its previous close at 2.75 percent.
